title: Time-Series Forecast reference solution and review guide
answer: A strong solution for Time-Series Forecast should meet the objective: Compare a simple historical baseline with a forecasting approach using chronological validation and an error measure in target units. It should preserve a repeatable test setup, document its assumptions, and distinguish measured results from hypotheses.
explanation: Review the reasoning, not only the required words: inspect whether the test design matches the objective, the result is reproducible, and limitations are reported honestly.

review_rubric.criterion: Technical correctness and fit to task
